dialogues.speaker: Egle
dialogues.text: Thanks for the thought, but I know I'm asking a lot here. After all, we Lightkeepers exist to bleed and make the ultimate sacrifice to safeguard our home.

dialogues.speaker: Egle
dialogues.text: I've lived in Piramida my whole life, so I'm familiar enough with all this. But I really thought I had already gotten used to all the goodbyes and the grief.

dialogues.speaker: Egle
dialogues.text: But it wasn't until I joined the Lightkeepers that the full weight of this sacrifice became clear to me...
